name: Four Seasons Hotel Gresham Palace
positioning: Art nouveau palace hotel at the foot of the Chain Bridge in Budapest, with views of the Danube
best_for: Travelers who want a base at the foot of the Chain Bridge with Danube views
Guests who want river and castle views from their room
Guests who enjoy afternoon tea or cocktails in the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is at Széchenyi István tér 5-6.
The hotel is located at the foot of the Chain Bridge, overlooking Széchenyi István Square.
The hotel is a luxury art nouveau palace.
The lobby is adorned with more than two million mosaic tiles.
KOLLÁZS is a contemporary French brasserie that overlooks the Chain Bridge and the Danube River.
MÚZSA is the hotel's lobby bar.
The Spa has a 12-metre indoor infinity-edge pool.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours for hotel guests.

highlights.text: The Danube River-View Room has sweeping views of the Danube and Castle Hill.
The Royal Suite has a private balcony with a view of the Danube flowing beneath the Chain Bridge, with the Buda Castle rising beyond.
Afternoon tea is served on hand-painted Herend porcelain.
The Spa offers a Hungarian Moor Mud Therapy treatment.

considerations.text: Afternoon tea is served on Saturday and Sunday, from 3:00 pm to 6:00 pm.
Spa treatments run from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm.
WhataHotel notes that the historic building may limit some modern amenities.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, full breakfast for two is included daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
